part: B — first API reader selection (decision + contract; NOT implemented)

inputs.minimal_read_only_verification: 2026-10-05 Eurostat SDMX 2.1 live GETs for DEMO_MLEXPEC (structure, bounded data slices, error behavior). No credentials, no writes, no database.

selection.BEST_EVENTUAL_TURKEY_SOURCE: TURKSTAT_HEALTH_STATISTICS (CANONICAL_GATED: token auth + unresolved terms) — later, not first
selection.why: The only shortlisted source that is simultaneously public (no auth), documented for automation, commercially reusable with attribution, machine-readable with bounded dimension-keyed queries, free of R2 needs, and carries Türkiye plus EU/peer comparators for a clinically meaningful annual indicator that exercises series/release/revision/provenance semantics.

shortlist_policy: At most 5 serious candidates; sources needing PDF-only parsing, ZIP/XLSX+R2, manual authenticated export, unresolved mandatory login or unresolved legal permission were excluded unless no API alternative existed (one gated source, TÜİK, is evaluated explicitly per B9). Scale: STRONG / MEDIUM / WEAK / BLOCKED / UNKNOWN (UNKNOWN is never converted to PASS or zero).

score_weights_note: Weights from the phase brief (P1 25%, product 20%, Turkey 15%, legal/access 15%, P2 10%, P3 5%, P4 10%; P5 is a hard gate, passed by every candidate). The ordering EUROSTAT > WHO > WORLD_BANK > UNICEF > TURKSTAT(first-reader eligibility) is ordinal and does not depend on fake numeric precision: Eurostat is the only candidate with no weak/unknown/blocked criterion that matters for a first activation.

official_endpoint_shape.representation: format=JSON returns JSON-stat 2.0 (class dataset): cheap to parse in a Worker (3.3 KB for 9 series × 3 years vs a 143 KB structure XML), carries `updated`, per-observation `status` flags, dimension category indexes and extension.datastructure/version
official_endpoint_shape.structure_optional: GET …/sdmx/2.1/dataflow/ESTAT/DEMO_MLEXPEC/latest?references=descendants&detail=referencepartial (XML, 143 KB; annotations UPDATE_DATA, UPDATE_STRUCTURE, DISSEMINATION_TIMESTAMP_DATA, OBS_PERIOD_OVERALL_OLDEST/LATEST). Fetch only when the DSD version changes.

source_native_ids.indicator: indicator_id = EUROSTAT_HEALTH:DEMO_MLEXPEC#LIFE_EXPECTANCY (one native measure; the series are distinguished by the age/sex/geo/unit dimensions, not by separate indicators)
source_native_ids.series_dimensions: typed core: unit_code = unit (YR), sex_code = sex (T|M|F), age_group_code = age (Y_LT1 = under 1 year = life expectancy at birth; others later), geography_id = geo; standardization/estimate type UNKNOWN until reviewed; freq is fixed 'A' (annual) and recorded as the extension dimension FREQ
source_native_ids.geography: ISO3 for TR; Eurostat geo codes TR, DE, EU27_2020 are SOURCE_NATIVE geographies (EU27_2020 = AGG) unless mapped; ISO3:TUR is the subject geography, source area stays GLOBAL_HEALTH_STATISTICS
source_native_ids.source_native_key: the SDMX key string, e.g. A.YR.T.Y_LT1.TR

reader_contract.bounded_unit: one dataflow × (sex ∈ {T,M,F}) × age = Y_LT1 × geo ∈ {TR + a fixed peer list} × a time window of ≤ 10 years. Normal first canary slice (verified 2026-10-05): A.YR.T+M+F.Y_LT1.TR+DE+EU27_2020, 2022–2024 → 9 series, 27 observations, 3.3 KB.
reader_contract.pagination_windowing: no cursor pagination: windowing by startPeriod/endPeriod only; an unbounded whole-flow request (65 years × all dimensions) is never made. Window end is clamped to the dataset's OBS_PERIOD_OVERALL_LATEST (or the JSON `time` category) because a period beyond the available range returns HTTP 400 INVALID_QUERY_DIMENSION_VALUE instead of an empty set (verified for startPeriod=2026). `lastTimePeriod` is NOT used (the JSON path ignores it).
reader_contract.release_change_detection: Compare the response `updated` timestamp (JSON) / UPDATE_DATA annotation (XML) with the checkpoint's last_source_stamp. Same stamp ⇒ skip with no database writes beyond the run row. New stamp ⇒ register a new API_SNAPSHOT release (release_key = 'updated:<ISO timestamp>', source_native_release_id = same, release_fingerprint = sha256 of the canonical request descriptor + the stamp + DSD version), then re-pull the bounded window and diff via the frozen value fingerprints (unchanged ⇒ confirmation only, changed ⇒ revision version).
reader_contract.checkpoint_key: dataset_id | unit_kind=API_STAMP | scope_key = 'DEMO_MLEXPEC|age=Y_LT1|sex=T+M+F|geo=<sorted codes>|window=<start>-<end>' ; cursor_text = last period reached; last_source_stamp = `updated`; last_content_fingerprint = sha256 of the normalized slice; parser_version = reader version. One run per scope (frozen uq_stat_runs_open_unit).
reader_contract.reference_period_mapping: TIME_PERIOD 'YYYY' → period key Y<year>, granularity YEAR, 01-01..12-31; source_period_key = the verbatim year string
reader_contract.value_mapping: present numeric → PRESENT with numeric_value and verbatim text_value; JSON-stat null/absent position → MISSING (never 0); status flags verbatim into status_flag_native (b = break in time series, e = estimated, p = provisional; combinations such as 'bep' preserved); finality: flag p ⇒ PROVISIONAL, else UNKNOWN until Eurostat's flag documentation is mapped (do not infer FINAL)
reader_contract.revision_handling: Upstream keeps latest values only, so history exists only from the first local snapshot onward: each new `updated` stamp that changes a value creates an immutable version (SOURCE_REVISION; reason stored only if Eurostat states one — it does not, so reason_origin NOT_STATED); unchanged values are confirmations; older stamps never displace newer ones (BACKFILL). Flag-only changes (e.g. p → final) are real value-fingerprint changes and become versions.
reader_contract.provenance_locator: sdmx:DEMO_MLEXPEC/{key}@{TIME_PERIOD} (e.g. sdmx:DEMO_MLEXPEC/A.YR.T.Y_LT1.TR@2024); API capture artifact req_<sha256> of the canonical request descriptor (URL without credentials — none exist) + response digest, backend EXTERNAL_REPRODUCIBLE, no bytes stored; retention R1_EVIDENCE
reader_contract.rate_limit_behavior: No limit headers and no documented limit (UNKNOWN). Conservative reader policy: sequential requests, one bounded slice per unit, ≤ 1 request/second, honour HTTP 429/503 Retry-After, exponential backoff with a bounded retry count, never parallel fan-out. The budget lives in rows_per_invocation_cap / daily_row_write_budget policy fields, not in code constants.
reader_contract.error_taxonomy: HTTP 400 INVALID_QUERY_DIMENSION_VALUE with a time-range fault ⇒ clamp window and retry once (not a failure); HTTP 400 for an unknown key value ⇒ SCHEMA_DRIFT; 401/403 ⇒ AUTH_FAILURE (never expected); 429/5xx/network ⇒ TRANSIENT_SOURCE_FAILURE; non-JSON/changed JSON-stat shape/unknown dimension order ⇒ PARSER_FAILURE or SCHEMA_DRIFT; inconsistent size/value positions ⇒ VALIDATION_FAILURE; maps to the frozen run failure_class values.
reader_contract.first_local_fixture: Recorded real response of A.YR.T+M+F.Y_LT1.TR+DE+EU27_2020 for 2022–2024 (3,347 bytes, 27 positions, flags bep/ep/b) committed as a test fixture, plus a second hand-edited copy with a later `updated` stamp and one changed value for the revision path, plus the HTTP 400 range-fault body, plus a null-position variant for MISSING.
reader_contract.first_local_e2e_slice: fixture → SDMX_READER (parse JSON-stat, map dimensions via category.index, never via key order) → local STATS_DB through createStatisticsRuntime → release (updated stamp) → run → checkpoint lease → ONE commitBoundedBatch of 27 observations (+9 series) → current projection → provenance trace; then the second fixture proves confirmation vs revision; replay and crash/replay reuse the foundation harness. All local, ephemeral DB, source policy simulated ACTIVE only inside the throw-away test DB.

estimated_d1_shape.canary_slice: 9 series + 9 dimension rows(FREQ) + 27 versions + 27 projection rows + 1 release + 1 run + 1 checkpoint + 1 request artifact ≈ 76 rows written (plus index entries) per first pull; a no-change poll writes the run row and checkpoint only
estimated_d1_shape.full_first_whitelist: illustrative: sex {T,M,F} × 2 age classes (Y_LT1 verified; the second to be confirmed against the DSD) × geo {TR, EU27_2020, ~5 peers} × 10 years ≈ 3 × 2 × 7 × 10 = 420 observations ⇒ ~9 batches of ≤ 50 observations; conservative caps remain configuration (account tier UNKNOWN)
